SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM MEMBER M
AND ( M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' OR M.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{searchDTO.keyword} || '%' )
AND M.STATUS = #{searchDTO.status}

SELECT RESERVATION_CODE, CLASS_CODE, CLASS_NAME, RESERVATION_DATE, PEOPLE_NUMBER, RESERVATION_STATUS, PAYMENT_CODE, AMOUNT, MEANS, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_STATUS, REFUND, REFUND_DATE
FROM (
SELECT A.*, ROWNUM RN
FROM (
SELECT R.RESERVATION_CODE, R.CLASS_CODE,
C.NAME AS CLASS_NAME,
R.RESERVATION_DATE, R.PEOPLE_NUMBER,
R.STATUS AS RESERVATION_STATUS,
P.PAYMENT_CODE, P.AMOUNT, P.MEANS, P.PAYMENT_DATE,
P.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS,
P.REFUND, P.REFUND_DATE
FROM RESERVATION R
INNER JOIN CLASS C ON C.CLASS_CODE = R.CLASS_CODE
LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.RESERVATION_CODE = R.RESERVATION_CODE
WHERE R.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode}
ORDER BY R.RESERVATION_DATE DESC, R.RESERVATION_CODE DESC
) A
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow}
)
WHERE RN >= #{startRow}
